observations.body: John, Elijah, Jeremiah, and one of the prophets appear before the disciples answer for themselves.
observations.label: Public reports

observations.body: Simon names Jesus, and Jesus answers with Simon’s family identity, blessedness, revelation, rock, assembly, and keys.
observations.label: Answer and address

observations.body: The exchange closes with a command not to tell anyone that Jesus is the Christ.
observations.label: Restriction

payload.posture: Distinguish the crowd reports, Peter’s sentence, Jesus’s reply, and the final command.
payload.tension: The identity is stated and affirmed while its public announcement is immediately restricted.
payload.title: You are the Christ
